name: Aman’Thul
shortDescription: The first titan to awaken in Chronicle's account, who crossed the Great Dark in search of others of his kind.
body: Aman’Thul's search gathered the awakened titans into the Pantheon. When the Pantheon confronted the corruption on Azeroth, his direct removal of Y'Shaarj revealed how deeply the Old Gods had rooted themselves in the world.
